description: Finds a Shopify store’s collections, pages and articles that rank #4–20 on Google in the store’s market (DataForSEO rankings), checks the most valuable on Google today, and gives each one’s searches, monthly volumes, a range of extra clicks from reaching #3 and the change it needs, plus pages that were near page one and have left the top 20, with the cause found. One rewritten title is previewed as a Google result. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds of a run’s usual 1–4 minutes. Shared per store for 7 days; anything not measured is reported as not checked.

country.description: The market to check, as a two-letter ISO country code such as GB. Omit it for the store’s main market.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.
